milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the player must navigate near the stonecutter (placed at spawn-relative [6, 1, 6] inside an oak plank building) and face toward it, modeling 'the player can see the stonecutter'. max_distance=16 allows detection from outside the building entrance or from inside, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking at the stonecutter rather than just passing nearby.
